name: Latch Palm
description: Strike the chest with a flat palm and press a latch of qi into the ribs so the breath catches.

name: Hasp Guard
description: Cross the forearms and clasp the qi shut over them like a hasp so a blow lands dull.

name: Bolt Step
description: Slide the rear foot across and throw the weight forward like a bolt shot home so the body ends square to the foe.

name: Shut Hand
description: Close a hand over the foe's wrist and seal the qi in that arm for a moment so the grip goes slack.

name: Closing Breath
description: Draw one slow breath and lock the qi low in the belly so the next blows land with steady weight.

name: Clasp Ward
description: Meet a thrust with a clasped-hand turn that closes the line and sends the point wide of the body.

name: Sealing Palm
description: Press a palm to the shoulder and drive a seal of qi through it so the arm tires and hangs.

name: Stopper Fist
description: Punch the belly with a fist capped by a stopper of qi so the foe's wind cannot rise for a beat.

name: Bar Guard
description: Set a bar of qi across the front of the body so a rush stalls against it.

name: Latch Step
description: Take a short step that latches the foot to the ground at its end and leaves the body ready to push off again.

name: Quiet Touch
description: Touch the foe's forearm and damp the qi there so the next strike comes slow and thin.

name: Mending Latch
description: Close a shallow cut with a latch of qi pressed along its edges in yourself or an ally.

name: Press Seal
description: Press two fingers to the foe's chest and seal a pulse of qi inside so a move is cut short.

name: Bolt Strike
description: Throw a straight blow whose qi drives home like a bolt and holds the foe's chest still a moment.

name: Dead Bolt
description: Throw the qi bolt across the front of the body so a heavy blow finds nothing to push open.

name: Bolt Sidestep
description: Shoot the rear foot sideways and stop it like a bolt seated so the body comes off the line cleanly.

name: Catch Turn
description: Catch a punch on the open palm and turn it aside while a catch of qi locks the elbow.

name: Pin Bolt
description: Drive a pinning blow into the instep with a bolt of qi so the foot stays rooted for one beat.

name: Calm Draw
description: Draw a calm breath and feel with sealed qi along the arms for the weight and line of a near foe.

name: Shut Breath
description: Hold the breath closed and bank the qi in the lower belly to feed the next several strikes.

name: Winded Palm
description: Strike under the ribs and seal the diaphragm for an instant so the foe cannot draw breath.

name: Stilled Guard
description: Hold a still film of sealed qi over the chest that takes a blow without any echo.

name: Hushed Step
description: Place each foot with the qi sealed to the sole so no sound or tremor carries from the stride.

name: Throat Seal
description: Close a palm at the throat and seal the voice and the breath for the span of one blow.

name: Breath Latch
description: Hold your breath and wrap the qi round a bruise to slow the pain and the swelling in yourself.

name: Stored Guard
description: Let a blow glance off the banked qi at the forearm and turn away with no shock to the bone.

name: Stopper Palm
description: Slap a palm to the foe's thigh and plug the qi there so the leg buckles on the next step.

name: Sealfast Fist
description: Punch the upper arm with a fist wrapped in a seal of qi that numbs the limb to the elbow.

name: Cork Guard
description: Plug the qi into the point of impact on the forearm so the force of the blow has nowhere to spread.

name: Seal Slide
description: Slide the lead foot across the ground on a thin seal of qi and plant it again exactly where aimed.

name: Stop Touch
description: Tap the foe's back and stop the flow of qi along the spine so the stance goes stiff.

name: Wrist Cap
description: Cap the foe's wrist with a ring of qi that locks the joint and stops the hand from closing.

name: Wax Press
description: Press a warm seal of qi over a bleeding wound as wax over a joint to stop the flow in yourself or an ally.

name: Stopper Turn
description: Turn the shoulder into a blow and stopper the force at the joint so it slides off the arm.

name: Knot Palm
description: Strike with a palm whose qi is tied in a tight knot that bursts inside the target on contact.

name: Cinch Guard
description: Cinch the qi tight round the torso so the ribs take a blow as one hard band.

name: Knot Step
description: Tie the qi at the ankle and spring from it so the step covers more ground than it should.

name: Cinch Hand
description: Throw a loop of qi round the foe's forearm and cinch it tight against the ribs for a heartbeat.

name: Knot Reading
description: Feel along the foe's qi for the knots where it is tied hard and tell where the next strike will fall.

name: Closed Fist
description: Throw a straight punch with the fist shut tight on the qi so the blow carries no wasted motion.

name: Closed Elbow
description: Fold the arm tight and drive the elbow in at close range with the qi held shut behind it.

name: Closed Ward
description: Hold both arms in tight before the chest with the qi shut so nothing finds an opening.

name: Shutter Guard
description: Snap the forearm across the line like a shutter and knock a thrust away to the side.

name: Closed Step
description: Close the distance in one tight step with the knees together and the qi shut behind the stride.

name: Fist Lock
description: Close both hands round the foe's fist and seal the qi in it so the fingers cannot open.

name: Lock Draw
description: Draw the qi inward and lock it at the core so the arms hold strength through a long exchange.

name: Holding Fist
description: Punch and leave the fist pressed in on the target so its qi is held down a moment after impact.

name: Hold Guard
description: Hold the forearms square and let sealed qi stiffen them so a heavy blow stops against them.

name: Hold Step
description: Plant each step and hold it a breath so the stance cannot be pushed back by a rush.

name: Fast Hold
description: Seize a sleeve or a wrist and hold it fast with a clamp of qi so the foe cannot pull free.

name: Rooted Hold
description: Hold the stance and let sealed qi settle in the legs and back until the whole frame feels rooted.

name: Hold Turn
description: Turn the held forearm outward to carry a blow past the body and leave the foe open.
